source_quote.quote: To correlate the presence of pathologically confirmed EGFR(epidermal growth factor receptor)-gene amplification with the presence of fluorescence signals, in- and ex vivo, as measured with NIR fluorescent imaging after administering Cetuximab-IRDye800CW.

GBM named in conditions, inclusion and arm label; high-grade glioma defined as glioblastoma grade 4 WHO, no IDH requirement or WHO edition, so cns5 unclear.
